test_series_str_get_dummies: test that Series.str.get_dummies splits strings by separator and returns a DataFrame of binary columns
test_index_str_get_dummies: test that Index.str.get_dummies splits strings by separator and returns a MultiIndex with binary column names
test_get_dummies_with_numeric_dtype: test that Series.str.get_dummies accepts numeric dtypes like uint8, int16, bool for the output DataFrame
test_get_dummies_with_pyarrow_dtype: test that Series.str.get_dummies accepts pyarrow dtypes like int8[pyarrow], bool[pyarrow] for the output DataFrame
test_get_dummies_with_invalid_dtype: test that Series.str.get_dummies raises ValueError when passed a non-numeric dtype like str or datetime64[ns]
